signal: Buy when the previous completed session close exceeds the close 60 sessions before it; otherwise cash.
entry: Regular-session open on every fifth exchange session starting at development session index 61.
exit: Regular-session open five exchange sessions after entry; exit before any new entry.
economic_hypothesis: Gradual adjustment to information may produce multi-week price persistence; lower turnover may preserve more gross return after costs. This ETF implementation is unproven.
allocation: One fixed equal-notional slot per symbol; inactive slots remain cash; no leverage, shorts, compounding or volatility targeting.
selection: One fixed rule and horizon, no parameter search, no models fitted.
acceptance: At least 60 nonoverlapping decision periods, 100 selections and 6 quarters with 12 selections each; positive 95 percent lower bounds versus cash and always-long at 10bps; positive aggregate at 20bps; 5 profitable quarters and 4 profitable symbols.
stop_rule: One trial only. Failure with adequate support retires; inadequate support consumes budget as inconclusive; crash requires audit, never automatic retry.
holdout_policy: Do not read or evaluate reserved holdout; no automatic future test or promotion. Development data was used in earlier research and is not untouched.
limitations: Split-adjusted price markouts omit distributions and cash interest; not total returns.
Aggregate opportunity means are not portfolio CAGR, Sharpe or drawdown.
No ML comparison exists until a separately justified model is frozen and evaluated on identical opportunities.
